result: In the part that can be aligned, the GTK2 bar has the same 15 px thickness and exact straight-track relief as the narrow attachment and canonical SR10.4 raster. The upper arrow cell has the same silhouette; its 50-pixel glyph and 11-pixel inner face use #6688b5 in GTK2 and the VM raster, while the narrow attachment uses the lighter #6f95c6. This is a color-state/provenance discrepancy, not evidence of a geometry regression. The direct VM raster and GTK2 agree; the narrow attachment's arrow shade does not.
